title: Gas & Bitumen Planner
description:
Transport Planner

Huddersfield

£35,000 + Benefits

Cast UK are working with a nationwide logistics company to recruit Planner to join their team based in Huddersfield. This is a key planning role responsible for coordinating and planning processes to ensure deliveries are made safely, efficiently and on time.

You'll play an important role in balancing customer demand with available resources, maximising driver and vehicle utilisation and ensuring all relevant safety, regulatory and customer requirements are met. The role will also involve developing strong relationships with customers, ensuring excellent levels of customer service and proactively managing any potential supply issues.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage inventory through stock reports, ensuring minimum and maximum stock levels are maintained.
- Liaise with customers and internal teams to align supply with customer demand.
- Plan deliveries effectively, ensuring they are compatible with the available driver, vehicle and equipment requirements.
- Work closely with the Control Team throughout the shift to resolve issues and keep deliveries on schedule.
- Reschedule dropped or delayed deliveries where required to maintain customer service levels and maximise fleet utilisation.
- Communicate proactively with clients regarding unplanned deliveries and potential low-stock situations.
- Identify and escalate any potential delivery issues that could result in stock outs and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
- Ensure resources are planned in a cost effective way while maintaining site stock levels and customer KPIs.
- Maintain accurate records and KPI information in line with contractual requirements.

Key Skills & Experience
- Proven problem solving ability within time critical environment.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Strong and clear communication and relationship building skills across all stakeholders.
- Microsoft Excel experience.
- Planning systems experience is desirable

title: IT Service Desk Analyst - 1st Line - Huddersfield
description:
IT Service Desk Analyst - 1st Line - Huddersfield

Service Desk Analyst / 1st Line IT Support Analyst with strong experience in Microsoft 365 and in an IT helpdesk or support role is required by a leading company in central Huddersfield

In this role, you will be the first line of support for IT issues across the firm, using your technical expertise to troubleshoot and resolve employee issues promptly and contribute to the team by providing an excellent IT support service.

Experience required:
- 6+ months experience in a similar 1st line IT support / service desk role
- Working with helpdesk software, MS Office 365, Azure & Windows 10 / 11
- Excellent understanding of various systems and a passion for learning about new and upcoming technology and software
- Ability to find solutions and assist staff at all levels
- Excellent communication skills
- Ability to prioritise tasks and deliver on deadlines
- Enthusiastic, hardworking and a team player
- Ability to drive for the odd occasion when you need to go to a different office

Job Role Responsibilities:
- Helpdesk / Telephone Support
- Building and deploying laptop clones
- Installing basic laptop components
- Provide basic Microsoft Office 365 support
- Escalate and manage 2nd and 3rd-line support tickets
- Carry out basic Active Directory tasks
- Able to support users remotely and on-premises
- Create user profiles
- Roll out software centrally and manually
- Offer user laptop health checks
- Managing all tasks via the helpdesk system
- Review ticket trends with the line manager
- Support team and firm with ad-hoc IT tasks

My client is a leading professional services company, employing over 350 people. They are looking for the right candidate to grow into this role and progress into a 2nd line role in the future.
